name: plasticity/pipeline
description: End-to-end plasticity pipeline: gate_gradients.json → analysis → compaction. The 'wake up to a compacted model' command. Given a gate capture directory and a model path, runs the full pipeline: load gradients, compute optimization plan, build topology, compact model (multi-shard aware), write compacted model + topology + analysis.

params.name: capturePath
params.description: Gate capture directory containing gate_gradients.json (from PEFT training with GateGradientCallback)

params.name: modelPath
params.description: Base model path — directory for multi-shard, file for single safetensors

params.name: outputPath
params.description: Output directory for compacted model. Default: <capturePath>/compacted/

params.name: config
params.description: CompactionConfig overrides: { minHeadsPerLayer, minKvHeadsPerLayer, deadThreshold, lowThreshold, highThreshold, saturatedThreshold, enableQuantization, targetSizeGb }

results.name: modelPath
results.description: Path to the compacted model safetensors

examples.description: Full pipeline: train → gate gradients → compact
